test_title: SSC CPO Tier-II Previous Year Paper (Held On: 8th November 2021)
subject: general
question: Which statement is NOT true according to the passage?

options.text: The longer-duration variety of soybean will not suffer much due to this excessive rain.
The rainfall in June was poor in MP.
In July, the rainfall was 63.6% above average.
The crops in low-lying areas were worst affected by rains.

solution:
The correct answer is **'****In July, the rainfall was 63.6% above average.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Let's have a look at the fourth sentence of the first paragraph of the passage: 

 
 
• *' *In July, they were 31.2% above average.'
 
• *​*It can be concluded from the above line that* *the statement 'In July, the rainfall was 63.6% above average.' is NOT true according to the passage. (यह निष्कर्ष निकाला जा सकता है कि statement 'In July, the rainfall was 63.6% above average.' गद्यांश के अनुसार सत्य नहीं है।)
 
 
 
• *​*Hence, the correct answer is 'In July, the rainfall was 63.6% above average.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 

 

 
• The meaning of the word 'excessive' is* *more than is necessary, normal, or desirable; immoderate. ('Excessive' शब्द का अर्थ है आवश्यकता से अधिक, सामान्य या वांछनीय; निरंकुश।)

 
 
• Example:* He was drinking **excessive** amounts of brandy.*
